worldData.instructions:
HELIOS — a story in chapters. One world.

MOVE — the light follows your cursor · CLICK & HOLD — hurry time / turn the light
Bottom corners — move between UNLOCKED chapters.

CHAPTER I — THE VALLEY: carry the sun; hold for the moon. Light the six stones to wake the tree. When the moon is full, its reflection on the lake invites you down.
CHAPTER II — THE DROWNED MOON: six phase-stones ring the deep; match the crescents. The moon-tree grows — step through it.
CHAPTER III — THE BEARER: seven stars wait. DRAG a thread of light from star to star — six threads write the light-carrier into the sky, then step through its door.
CHAPTER IV — THE FIRST LIGHT: the void before any sun. Cup the faint spark and HOLD to feed it; keep still, or the dark eats its edges. Kindle it whole and it ignites into the first light.

Progress persists per chapter.

worldData.instructions:
HELIOS — a story in chapters. One world.

MOVE — the light follows your cursor · CLICK & HOLD — hurry time / turn the light
Bottom corners — move between UNLOCKED chapters.

CHAPTER I — THE VALLEY: carry the sun; hold for the moon. Light the six stones to wake the tree. When the moon is full, its reflection on the lake invites you down.
CHAPTER II — THE DROWNED MOON: six phase-stones ring the deep; match the crescents. The moon-tree grows — step through it.
CHAPTER III — THE BEARER: seven stars wait. DRAG a thread of light from star to star — six threads write the light-carrier into the sky, then step through its door.
CHAPTER IV — THE FIRST LIGHT: the void before any sun. Cup the faint spark and HOLD to feed it; keep still, or the dark eats its edges. Kindle it whole and it ignites into the first light.

Progress persists per chapter.

CHAPTER V — THE QUORUM: a playable round of the chant. MOUSE — steer your node · R — restart the round. Drifting words flee your light; gather five into your orbit to form a cell; the cell resolves and a tier lamp lights. Settle all five tiers to crown the champion. (Unlocked by kindling the First Light.)

CHAPTER VI — THE CHORUS: the crowned champion gives the light back. MOUSE — lead · R — restart. The words follow you now; shepherd two or more onto each of the six pillars until all six sing. When the chorus stands, dawn comes — the bottom door carries the song home. (Unlocked by crowning the champion in Chapter V.)

worldData.instructions:
ONE DAY — a lighthouse, a whole day, one room of light.

DRAG THE BOTTOM EDGE — the slider is the clock; the sun obeys it
DRAG THE LIGHTHOUSE — carry it across the sea (time holds its breath)

CLICK THE LAMP OR THE SUN — climb into THE LANTERN ROOM, where the
great lens turns. The stair (low center) leads back down.

And at low light the lamp sweeps: lay the beam on the sun and the water

Three pearls sleep in the sea. Gather all three and bring them home to the lighthouse dock (just south of the light) — arrive slow, sails eased. Every pearl aboard makes her heavier on the helm. Rocks and the maelstrom eat hull; three hits and the sea reclaims everything. Fastest homecoming is the record.

worldData.instructions:
QUANTIC DOJO — The Evolution of Tic-Tac-Toe. By Galen Radtke.

XIN (X, magenta) versus OHN (O, green). The DOJO MIND plays Ohn — click the green lamp by Ohn's pieces to switch to two-player hotseat.

CLICK a piece on your side · R or your ring rotates it · CLICK an orange/white square to place it
Each face is a little tic-tac-toe: your mark stands where the piece stands; the colored flag is its ATTACK ZONE, pointing where victims get pushed. Ranged pieces show mark and zone on opposite edges — the empty span between says it strikes past the first square.
Pushes chain through rows. Off the board = back to hand. Three hits in one turn breaks a piece forever.
Chain attacks: when a flashing piece of yours can strike, click it.

THREE-IN-A-ROW at the end of any turn WINS. Both at once is a draw. Can't place? You lose. The bar below resigns with honor.

worldData.instructions:
HELIOS — a story in chapters. One world.

MOVE — the light follows your cursor · CLICK & HOLD — hurry time / turn the light
Bottom corners — move between UNLOCKED chapters.

CHAPTER I — THE VALLEY: carry the sun; hold for the moon. Light the six stones to wake the tree. When the moon is full, its reflection on the lake invites you down.
CHAPTER II — THE DROWNED MOON: six phase-stones ring the deep; match the crescents. The moon-tree grows — step through it.
CHAPTER III — THE BEARER: seven stars wait. DRAG a thread of light from star to star — six threads write the light-carrier into the sky, then step through its door.
CHAPTER IV — THE FIRST LIGHT: the void before any sun. Cup the faint spark and HOLD to feed it; keep still, or the dark eats its edges. Kindle it whole and it ignites into the first light.

Progress persists per chapter.
